body:
Integration seat, 14:25 MST. Four items, most urgent first.

1. PR #4063 needs review: it blocks any promotion from integration. origin/integration 7d0c929ce9d fails `contained_boundary::store_tests::bug_1985_host_status_guard` (verified on dell1 at that exact commit). #4022 (STORY-2772 slice 1) ran `git status` through integration_cmd.rs's raw git wrapper. The fix moves only that status call to the hardened host git command. Head b8f40745a63, Refs STORY-2772. dell1 run and fast gate are in progress; I will post results on the PR. Main does not have the call.

2. PR #4055 (S3b WIP limit) has its tested head for the delta review: 203545e337c. It answers both blocking items: a --branch pickup at or over the limit is recorded (gate event wip-limit-override), and there is an end-to-end test through `aida queue work` (story_2768_queue_work_refuses_a_new_spec_at_the_open_change_limit) plus a classifier unit test. dell1: check clean, 334 passed for `wip_limit bug_2451 bug_2501 bug_2549 queue_work story_2768 bug_1723 config_cmd`. Fast gate: 48 passed (first run failed one unrelated codegraph proxy test, "proxy did not start"; the rerun passed).

3. The held candidate 31ab86c57e2 (#4047 + main ce660d5 + #3950): the seat_clone handshake test is not a regression. Alone it passes at 7d0c929, 7b2a677, c1ce2e9 and 31ab86c (3 runs each). Run together with `deputy_shell agent_launcher story2745` it fails at 7d0c929 as well as at the candidate (3 of 3 at each): another test in the same process binds an advisor seat grant to the test process, and the handshake test then reads "an advisor is live but unregistered". So it is test interference that predates the candidate; `a_paused_deputy_claims_nothing`, `status_tells_queued_running_done_and_cancelled_apart` and `apply_agent_default_flags_sets_contained_flag_for_claude` also fail intermittently at both commits. I have not filed a bug for it; say if you want one. The candidate inherits the guard failure of item 1, so I will rebuild it on top of #4063 once that is approved, with #4056, rather than push a second red tip.

4. PR #4058 (S3a): all seven findings are fixed locally at c3cc4ccc2f0 (origin tmp/s3a-r1), not yet on the PR branch. dell1: 249 passed, the only failure being the inherited guard test of item 1. Fast gate is queued. I will push to the PR branch and mail you the head when the gate passes.
subject: Integration: #4063 blocks promotion (review); #4055 head 203545e337c; candidate finding; #4058 status
